items.evidence_note: Barbershop pill + H1 names barbershop; sub names queue, pay, reports
Sub states specific capability: scan to book, one tablet for queue, pay, reports
H1, sub, Start free CTA and hero photo all above the 900px fold
No number or rating in hero or nav; ticker lists capabilities only
H1 is a manifesto line; no 'unlike booking apps' or 'the only' statement in hero
Trial / no card / no contract line directly under hero CTA (low contrast)
Hero is a stock-style barber photo; no product UI or device mockup
Main promise has no number or timeframe; 'under five minutes' sits far below in setup section
All H2s stay on running the shop on one system
Per-barber revenue and DuitNow/card claims backed by product screens and compare table
Problem section has one abstract line ('stops at the appointment'); concrete shop pains are commented out in data.ts
Hero carries one message: one tablet runs the shop
Compare table names 'Typical booking app' with row-by-row reasons
Carousel pairs features with results, e.g. per-barber revenue at close, no detective work
Primary CTA 'Start free' uses an action verb
FAQ covers setup time, switching, devices, cancellation
Problem line, then product surfaces, then setup, compare, pricing (problem is thin)
Testimonial names before (three different apps) and after (one app)
4 of 8 H2s are benefit-led (calm shop, ready before first customer, grows with shop, stop juggling)
Hero uses unexplained 'Plus-equivalent trial'; carousel uses 'POS' and 'caps' without context
All 7 primary CTAs read 'Start free'
'See cost for a 3-barber shop' link to /compare exists mid-page
Your tablet, your laptop, your devices across key sections
No usage-to-result metric anywhere
No customer or partner logos in first two sections
'Saturday used to mean three different apps. Now we open Meikigo'
Visible internal note 'Named pilot quotes with photos come next'; FAQ sub 'Answers to your question' singular
Quotes attributed to barbershop owners about queue and Saturday rush
First name + role + shop name, initial avatar, no photo
No review badge, press, award, or security/payment-partner badge
Privacy and Terms links in footer
Testimonials have no link to case study or video
Full pricing section on page with monthly/yearly toggle
Start free is lime in hero/nav/Plus/close but black on Starter and Pro cards
Start free in nav, hero, pricing, closing band
No demo video, walkthrough, or tour next to Start free
Hero does not say what happens after Start free (form, shop setup, QR ready)
Evergreen persona page; urgency not expected
Real UI screens in three-screens block and carousel; problem imagery is stylised stock
H1 > H2 > body; lime CTA distinct
Hero sub, trial line, and trust ticker are white on light beige photo; hard to read
Short lines, cards, table; no long text blocks
3 top-level links (below 4) plus CTA and Login
10 sections, one goal (Start free)
Lime accent on ink/linen; carousel pastels are backgrounds
Clickable three-screens switcher and auto-playing product carousel
7 FAQs on product, setup, payment, cancellation
Consistent icon style, no emojis
Single unlabelled row of 7 links; no labelled sections
